title: Weather App User can have weather refresh automatically at a regular interval so that they don't have to manually reload to see current conditions

milestones.notes: Handoff comment posted on Plane WEATHER-4. 8 testable AC, size M, flagged timing/concurrency risk. Depends on WEATHER-3.

WEATHER-3's useCurrentConditions already covers AC-1,3,4,5 (auto-refresh, keep-last-good, staleness). Found two real gaps requiring a fix, not just new tests: AC-7 (no reset on Location switch — stale data briefly shows under new Location's name) and AC-8 (manual-refresh-during-in-flight-auto-refresh race). Plan: extend useCurrentConditions with refresh() + location-change reset + request-sequencing guard; wire a Refresh control into CurrentConditionsCard. Ledger created, 8 rows pending.

next_step: TDD loop: extend useCurrentConditions.ts (refresh trigger, location-switch reset, race guard), then wire Refresh control into CurrentConditionsCard + CurrentConditionsContainer.
